one_line: A late Indo-Greek king of the Kabul–Paropamisadae highlands, balancing Greek heritage and Central Asian realities amid the slow eclipse of Indo-Greek power.

appearance.age_look: mid-30s, athletic but slightly weather-worn from campaigning in highlands
appearance.face: Oval face with high cheekbones, straight nose and a neatly trimmed short beard and moustache; medium olive complexion with sun-darkened tone; sharp grey-brown eyes with slightly heavy brows; default expression calm, alert and calculating, as if quietly assessing shifting alliances.
appearance.hair: Thick dark brown hair cut to mid-neck, straight and combed back from the forehead, with a simple narrow white cloth fillet tied around the head; no helmet in default look.
appearance.costume: A knee-length Indo-Greek military tunic in undyed off-white wool, banded at the hem and sleeves with narrow burgundy and dark green woven stripes; over this, a fitted sleeveless scale-armour corselet of small bronze-coloured scales laced on brown leather, stopping just above the tunic’s belt; around his waist, a broad dark brown leather belt with a plain bronze buckle; over his left shoulder, a thick woollen cloak in muted burgundy pinned at the right shoulder with a small round bronze brooch and draped around his back, practical for Paropamisadae’s cooler climate; loose, straight trousers in muted dark green reaching to the ankles, tucked into mid-calf brown leather boots with simple lacings; on his right wrist, a plain bronze bangle, and on his left hand, a modest bronze signet-style ring, hinting at royal status without ostentation.
appearance.signature: A straight, slightly tapering iron sword (xiphos-like) with a simple bronze hilt and no crossguard, sheathed in a brown leather scabbard with bronze fittings and worn suspended from his belt on the left hip, which he often rests his hand upon in pensive poses.

ref_desc: Hermaeus is a mid-30s olive-skinned Indo-Greek king with an oval bearded face, mid-neck dark brown hair bound by a white fillet, wearing off-white tunic, bronze scale corselet, burgundy cloak, dark green trousers, brown boots and carrying a bronze-hilted straight sword at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Hermaeus, a late Indo-Greek king: a mid-30s man with an athletic build, olive sun-darkened skin, an oval face with high cheekbones, straight nose, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, and sharp grey-brown eyes under slightly heavy brows; his thick dark brown hair reaches mid-neck and is combed back from the forehead, held by a narrow white cloth fillet tied around his head. Dress him in an era-accurate Indo-Greek outfit: a knee-length off-white wool tunic with narrow burgundy and dark green bands at the hem and sleeves, over which he wears a fitted sleeveless bronze-coloured scale-armour corselet laced on brown leather; a broad dark brown leather belt with a simple bronze buckle at his waist; a thick woollen cloak in muted burgundy pinned at the right shoulder with a small round bronze brooch and draped across his back; loose straight dark green trousers tucked into mid-calf brown leather boots with simple lacings. Add a plain bronze bangle on his right wrist and a modest bronze signet-style ring on his left hand. His signature weapon is a straight, slightly tapering iron sword with a simple bronze hilt and no crossguard, in a brown leather scabbard with bronze fittings hanging at his left hip, with his right hand often resting lightly on the hilt. Use a palette of off-white, burgundy, dark green, brown leather and bronze, and present him front-facing with clear views of face, hair, clothing and sword for consistent redrawing.
